meta.name: cost-optimization
meta.description: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 降低云服务开支并优化资源使用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的云服务账单持续走高又难以定位浪费。
copy.tagline_en: Cut cloud costs and optimize resource usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your cloud bill keeps climbing and you can't find where the waste is.

howto.what: 当用户提出云成本优化相关请求时，Claude会依据该技能提供跨AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI的建议，涵盖资源规格调整、标签策略、预留实例与支出分析，并可给出Terraform配置示例和成本节省比例参考。
howto.when: 当用户要求减少云支出、分析基础设施成本或实施成本治理时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化AWS云成本，找出可降配的EC2实例。
say.note: Claude会分析资源利用率并给出调整建议。

say.text: 给Azure资源设置预算告警，超过80%就通知我们。
say.note: Claude会提供预算告警的配置方法或示例。

say.text: 用生命周期策略把S3里30天前的文件转成低频访问。

howto.what_en: When asked to optimize cloud costs, Claude provides recommendations across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI covering rightsizing, tagging, reserved instances, and spending analysis, including Terraform config examples and savings percentage references.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to reduce cloud spending, analyze infrastructure costs, or implement cost governance policies.

say_en.text: Help me optimize AWS cloud costs and find EC2 instances that can be downsized.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes utilization and suggests adjustments.

say_en.text: Set up a budget alert for Azure resources, notify us above 80%.
say_en.note: Claude provides budget alert configuration methods or examples.

say_en.text: Apply S3 lifecycle policy to move files older than 30 days to Standard-IA.
say_en.note: Claude provides the corresponding Terraform config.
